capacity: automated distinct process; not a human

criteria.basis: Five ordered classes and a closed catalog with no dashboard-exposed mutation.
A live reversible operation used a single-use, scope-bound approval and a token-free, source-bound audit.

checks.name: commit_exists
checks.detail: The reviewed source commit is present in this repository.

checks.name: five_risk_classes
checks.detail: Risk classes: inspection, reversible_mutation, destructive_mutation, upload, publishing.

checks.name: closed_catalog_classes
checks.detail: Every risk class has at least one catalog operation.

checks.name: playtest_catalog
checks.detail: Start and stop are cataloged as start_stop_play.

checks.name: distinct_parameter_digests
checks.detail: Start and stop use distinct parameter digests.

checks.name: audit_presence
checks.detail: Both operations have issued, started, and succeeded audit decisions.

checks.name: audit_no_token
checks.detail: The captured audit entries contain no approval token or token hash.

checks.name: scope_bound
checks.detail: Approval and audit scopes bind the reviewed Studio instance, place, and source revision.

limitations: This is an automated distinct process, not a human reviewer; it does not add human judgment or identity attestation.
The review did not re-run the live Studio start/stop sequence; it verified the source-bound record and the current read-only Studio state.
The live evidence covers reversible playtest only; Rojo sync, save, destructive mutation, upload, publishing, and multiplayer/device behavior are out of scope.
The approval issuer label is supplied by the local mission and is not cryptographically authenticated.
